acceptance.given: An aggregate execution is run through the bounded toolchain execution path and allowed to terminate.

oracle.expected: The aggregate reaches a single deterministically identified terminal state within the configured time and output budget.
forbidden: The aggregate ends in an indeterminate or nondeterministic terminal state.
Budget exhaustion is reported as successful.
oracle.observable: The replay/test result records the aggregate terminal category, bounded-resource outcome, and deterministic identity of that terminal result.

acceptance.then: The terminal result is inspected after execution completes.

failure_intents.selector_intent: The aggregate terminal-state assertion must fail when execution produces no unique terminal category or exceeds the budget.
The aggregate execution must fail when bounded execution yields no observable terminal result.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Exercise aggregate execution through the real bounded runner and assert one deterministic terminal category, with budget exhaustion unsuccessful.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing terminal-category and bounded-budget semantics; revert only the aggregate execution assertion changes.

slice_hint.state_transition: aggregate executing -> bounded terminal result (success or unsuccessful budget outcome)
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Exactly one terminal category is recorded for the aggregate and the result is not successful when the budget is exhausted.

acceptance.given: A detached Probe is presented with an always-success false-negative condition.

oracle.expected: The Probe outcome is failed and identifies the always-success false-negative condition.
forbidden: The Probe passes the always-success false-negative condition.
The condition is treated as an infrastructure failure without the required false-negative diagnosis.
oracle.observable: The independent Probe result contains a failed verdict and the diagnostic category for always-success false negative.

acceptance.then: The detached Probe result and diagnostic category are evaluated.
acceptance.when: When an always-success false negative occurs

failure_intents.selector_intent: The constraint check must fail if the always-success false-negative case is not represented as a failed Probe outcome.
The check must fail if the Probe evidence omits the diagnostic category needed to distinguish the false negative.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Run the detached Probe against an always-success false-negative input and verify a failed, diagnostically classified outcome.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Retain independent-process Probe input/output binding and existing failure taxonomy.

slice_hint.state_transition: Probe input bound -> failed Probe outcome with false-negative diagnostic
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Probe verdict is failed and its diagnostic category is always-success false negative.

acceptance.given: An aggregate is evaluated with matrix evidence whose label does not match the evidence content or case identity.

oracle.expected: The aggregate is marked invalid and cannot be accepted or promoted.
forbidden: The aggregate remains valid or is accepted despite mislabeled matrix evidence.
The mislabeled evidence is silently relabeled or ignored.
oracle.observable: The aggregate evaluation artifact records invalid status and the specific mislabeled-evidence reason.

acceptance.then: The aggregate validity and acceptance decision are inspected after matrix-evidence evaluation.

failure_intents.selector_intent: The governance check must fail if mislabeled matrix evidence is absent, copied, or not tied to the invalid aggregate verdict.
The governance check must fail if the aggregate can still be accepted after label/content mismatch.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Evaluate a matrix-label/content mismatch and require an invalid, non-acceptable aggregate verdict.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing aggregate validity and promotion gates; revert only the mislabeled-evidence assertion path.

slice_hint.state_transition: aggregate evaluated -> invalid aggregate with acceptance blocked
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Aggregate status is invalid, acceptance is false, and the reason identifies mislabeled matrix evidence.

acceptance.given: An external process is launched through the bounded process executor and allowed to terminate.

oracle.expected: The external process reaches one deterministically identified terminal state within the configured time and output budget.
forbidden: The external process ends in an indeterminate or nondeterministic terminal state.
Budget exhaustion is reported as successful.
oracle.observable: The process execution result records its terminal category, exit/timeout classification, and bounded-resource outcome.

acceptance.then: The external-process result is inspected after the process exits or is stopped by the budget.
acceptance.when: When each external process execution terminates

failure_intents.selector_intent: The process terminal-state assertion must fail when no unique terminal category is produced or the process exceeds its budget.
The process execution must fail when timeout or output limits prevent observing a terminal result.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Execute an external process with bounded time/output and assert deterministic terminal classification, treating budget exhaustion as unsuccessful.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve process invocation, timeout, output-limit, and terminal-category contracts.

slice_hint.state_transition: external process executing -> deterministic terminal result
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Exactly one terminal category and bounded-resource status are recorded; budget exhaustion yields an unsuccessful result.
